items.title: Craft After Conflict: Why Rebuilding Cities Begins with Rebuilding Knowledge
items.summary: A war can erase a skyline overnight. Roofs collapse, streets become impassable, and landmarks that once oriented everyday life are reduced to rubble. The most profound loss often remains invisible. Buildings can be surveyed, photographed, scanned, and, eventually, rebuilt.
